root_cause: scripts/check-loc.sh (do-harness `loc` sensor + pre-commit hook) walked $ROOT/src and $ROOT/crates, neither of which exists in this workspace, so it matched zero files and printed `check-loc OK` on every commit. Six source files drifted past the 500 LOC invariant between v0.1.40 and now (checkpoint.rs 330->554, episode/core/types.rs 490->503, memory/checkpoint/compact.rs new 514, patterns/similarity.rs 395->533, storage/backend.rs 480->502, mcp/tools/checkpoint/tool.rs 415->713) without any sensor firing.
guide_updated: agent_docs/LESSONS.md#lesson-026 + AGENTS.md (core invariant 'Files: <=500 LOC per source file')
resolution: Repaired the sensor to select files with `git ls-files '*.rs'` plus untracked ones and apply the same test-file carve-out as the blocking gate in scripts/quality-gates.sh; split the six files at cohesive seams (inline test modules to sibling */tests.rs, types.rs payloads to types/models.rs, compact byte-budget helpers to compact/budget.rs). Found only when `release-manager ship` stopped at the quality-gates phase: main CI had stayed green because its Quality Gates job runs the security audit and coverage steps only. Fixed in PR #1026.
